title: Files read before the batch deadline are thrown away: every file is marked unread
evidence: Closed by decision 2026-11-26 (Brad: "go with your recommendations" on "Files lost when a lab batch times out (self-hosted build)"): no change. It touches only the GitHub Pages build and is rare. widget-src/src/lib/upload-pipeline.ts processBatch throws UploadError 'timeout' at the deadline with no partial results, and widget-src/src/hooks/useUploadFlow.ts marks every file unread. On the website a re-pick joins the live batch (US-12 AC25). Found with US-12 AC5b
